title: The positions of Salah
intro: Standing, bowing, prostrating and sitting – and what we say in each.

learn.html: In Salah our body moves through a few positions. Between them we say Allaahu akbar – Allah is the Greatest.

items.label: Qiyam – standing; we recite Al-Fatiha and a surah
Ruku‘ – bowing, hands on the knees
Qawmah – standing up again after ruku‘
Sajdah – forehead and nose on the ground; we do it twice
Jalsah – a short sitting between the two sajdahs
Qa‘dah – the sitting at the end; we recite At-Tahiyyat

learn.label: Opening takbir – we raise our hands
In ruku‘ – 3 times
learn.en: Glory be to my Lord, the Most Great.

learn.label: Standing up from ruku‘
learn.ar: سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ، رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ
learn.en: Allah hears the one who praises Him. Our Lord, to You belongs all praise.

learn.label: In sajdah – 3 times
learn.en: Glory be to my Lord, the Most High.

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: One rak‘ah = standing, one ruku‘ and two sajdahs. In sajdah we are closest to Allah.
